title: The Longest Crypto Bear Market Ever - But What Happens Next Is Insane!
description: $BTC has gone more than 400 days without a new high, longer than any of the last three big bear markets took from top to bottom, but one simple rule says this may not be the longest bear market at all.

I walk through both sides, from the 267 day, 53% first leg and the 51 days above the 50-week SMA and 200-day average, to the 200-week SMA near $68,000, the SpaceX and Anthropic IPOs, rate fears, and where I stand on what comes next.
